summary: Complete rebuild architecture for Litdom Batch Studio: a streamlined, high-speed, spreadsheet-driven design batch population tool. Replaces the 7-tab workflow with a 2-screen mobile-first workspace (Dashboard and Unified Workspace), a shared project text template with 1000px proportional scaling, an IndexedDB Blob-based image store with automatic migration, instant spreadsheet population with fuzzy/positional mapping, touch-optimized drag-and-drop editing, full-resolution canvas rendering with font preloading, and high-speed ZIP/PNG export.
